source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Note any discrepancies or inconsistencies with the provided information. Include any missing or incomplete information in your documentation.
3. Record any visual observations such as damaged equipment, malfunctioning machinery, or unsaviorily conditions. Document this information in detail.
4. Engage with the project managers and other relevant personnel involved in the audit process. Determine if there were any expectations or deviations from the established best practices. Document this information comprehensively.
5. If applicable, document any communication breakdown or miscommunication between the project manager and the other team members. Describe the exact nature of the miscommunication and the impact it had on the inspection process.
6. Note any lack of proper training or documentation provided to the project manager. Indicate whether there were any issues with the personnel's understanding of safe working practices, industry standards, or local regulations. Provide specific examples whenever possible.
7. Explain any issues with the quality of the cleaners or the products used in the workplace
